description: Write a comparison report of two STEP files (parts or assemblies) as a self-contained HTML file that can be printed to PDF: verdict, the list of differences in plain language, key figures, and for assemblies the changed, added, removed and moved parts. By default it also contains an interactive 3D view (rotate, zoom, measure; click a difference in the list to show it), which works offline in any browser. Use it when the user wants something to keep, send to a colleague or supplier, or attach to a change request, or wants to see the change in 3D. It writes one file on this computer and never overwrites one unless overwrite is true. Returns the path and a file:// url; give the user the url as a link to open it. Requires CAD Compare Pro (see describe → license).

a.description: Absolute path to the first file (A, usually the older version), a part or an assembly (.step or .stp) on this computer. For a file the user attached to the chat, pass the path you have; if it is not on this computer, the file with the same name in the user's folders is used

b.description: Absolute path to the second file (B) (.step or .stp) on this computer. For a file the user attached to the chat, pass the path you have; if it is not on this computer, the file with the same name in the user's folders is used

language.description: Report language: en, de or zh (Chinese); default en. Use the user's language

output.description: Absolute path for the report, ending in .html (default: next to B, named <A>_vs_<B>.html)

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file at output (default false; ask the user first)

view_3d.description: Include the interactive 3D view (default true; makes the file a few MB). Set false for a small, print-only report

name: export_report

path.description: Absolute path of the written HTML report

url.description: file:// address of the report; give it to the user as a link to open in the browser

view_3d.description: The report contains an interactive 3D view of the parts with the differences coloured (shown in the browser, not printed)
